settings.support.blurb.original: If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting its development:
settings.support.blurb.translation: Má tá an breiseán seo úsáideach duit, smaoinigh ar thacú lena fhorbairt:

settings.support.mission.original: …and help seed a bigger vision: technology that serves people and planet..
settings.support.mission.translation: …agus cuidigh le fís níos mó a chur: teicneolaíocht a fhreastalaíonn ar dhaoine agus ar an bpláinéad.

settings.support.license.viewTooltip.translation: Féach ar an gceadúnas & an séanadh

settings.support.license.acceptLabel.translation: Glac leis an gceadúnas & leis an séanadh

settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.original: Path to the templater plugin template file to use
settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.translation: Conair chuig comhad teimpléid an bhreiseáin Templater atá le húsáid

settings.transcripts.info.original: Transcript settings control how and where your extracted notes are saved, which youtube data API key to use (required for channel/playlist processing), and optional language-translation parameters.
settings.transcripts.info.translation: Rialaíonn na socruithe tras-scríbhinne conas agus cá sábháiltear do chuid nótaí, cén eochair API sonraí YouTube a úsáidtear (riachtanach do chainéil agus do sheinmliostaí), agus paraiméadair roghnacha aistriúcháin.

settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.original: The root folder where transcript subfolders will be organized (e.g., inbox, notes, etc.)
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.translation: An fillteán fréimhe ina n-eagrófar na fofhillteáin tras-scríbhinne (m.sh. inbox, notes srl.)

settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.original: Your Google cloud console API key for accessing public YouTube transcripts (not an OAUTH token). Required for downloading channels and playlists.
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.translation: D'eochair API Google cloud console chun teacht ar thras-scríbhinní poiblí YouTube (ní comhartha OAUTH é). Riachtanach chun cainéil agus seinmliostaí a íoslódáil.

settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.place.translation: Cuir an eochair API isteach (tosaíonn sí le aiza)

settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.original: Optional key for scrapecreators transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method. Get a free key at app.scrapecreators.com (100 requests free). Recommended for reliable transcript retrieval; direct YouTube extraction breaks when YouTube changes how captions are served.
settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.translation: Eochair roghnach don tseirbhís tras-scríbhinne scrapecreators. Nuair a shocraítear í, úsáidtear í mar phríomhmhodh. Faigh eochair saor in aisce ag app.scrapecreators.com (100 iarratas saor). Moltar í le haghaidh tras-scríbhinní iontaofa; briseann an bhaint dhíreach ó YouTube nuair a athraíonn YouTube an tslí a gcuirtear fotheidil ar fáil.
Cuir an eochair API scrapecreators isteach

settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.original: Optional key for supadata transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method (if no scrapecreators key). Get a key at supadata.ai.
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.translation: Eochair roghnach don tseirbhís tras-scríbhinne supadata. Nuair a shocraítear í, úsáidtear í mar phríomhmhodh (mura bhfuil eochair scrapecreators ann). Faigh eochair ag supadata.ai.

settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.original: Target language code for translation (e.g., en, es, fr, de). Use "en" to keep content in english.
settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.translation: Cód na sprioctheanga don aistriúchán (m.sh. en, es, fr, de). Úsáid “en” chun an t-ábhar a choinneáil i mBéarla.

settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.original: Target country/region code for translation (e.g., us, gb, ca). Used for region-specific language variants.
settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.translation: Cód na sprioctíre nó an réigiúin don aistriúchán (m.sh. us, gb, ca). Úsáidtear é le haghaidh leaganacha teanga réigiúnacha.

settings.llm.info.original: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and pick a model. Temperature controls creativity; max tokens caps output length. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; Google's gemini-2.5-flash is cheaper, but its lower-cost tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.info.translation: Roghnaigh soláthraí AI, cuir a eochair API isteach, agus roghnaigh múnla. Rialaíonn an teocht an chruthaitheacht; cuireann uasmhéid na gcomharthaí teorainn le fad an aschuir. Moltar OpenRouter mar gheall ar a iontaofacht; tá gemini-2.5-flash ó Google níos saoire, ach féadfar na leibhéil is saoire a mhaolú.

settings.llm.provider.desc.original: Provider used for summarization. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; lower-cost Gemini tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.provider.desc.translation: An soláthraí a úsáidtear le haghaidh achoimrithe. Moltar OpenRouter mar gheall ar a iontaofacht; féadfar na leibhéil Gemini is saoire a mhaolú.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.original: Stored in Obsidian secret storage, not in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.translation: Stóráilte i stór rúnda Obsidian, ní i sonraí an bhreiseáin.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.original: Server URL, stored in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.translation: URL an fhreastalaí, stóráilte i sonraí an bhreiseáin.

settings.llm.model.desc.original: Select a preset model or type a custom model name below.
settings.llm.model.desc.translation: Roghnaigh múnla réamhshocraithe nó clóscríobh ainm múnla saincheaptha thíos.

settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.original: Required: this model isn't in the registry — set context window, max output, and reserve % so token budgeting can size requests safely.
settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.translation: Riachtanach: níl an múnla seo sa chlár — socraigh an fhuinneog chomhthéacs, an t-uasaschur agus an céatadán cúltaca ionas gur féidir méid na n-iarratas a ríomh go sábháilte.

settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.original: These are this model's token limits, prefilled from known data. Edit a field to override it for this provider and model.
settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.translation: Seo teorainneacha comharthaí an mhúnla seo, réamhlíonta ó shonraí aitheanta. Cuir réimse in eagar chun é a shárú don soláthraí agus don mhúnla seo.

settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.original: Total context window in thousands of tokens (e.g., 400 for 400k tokens)
settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.translation: An fhuinneog chomhthéacs iomlán i mílte comharthaí (m.sh. 400 le haghaidh 400k comhartha)

settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.original: Maximum output tokens in thousands (e.g., 128 for 128k tokens)
settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.translation: Uaslíon comharthaí aschuir i mílte (m.sh. 128 le haghaidh 128k comhartha)

settings.llm.inputMax.desc.original: Explicit input cap if vendor publishes one (leave empty to auto calculate)
settings.llm.inputMax.desc.translation: Teorainn shainráite ionchuir má fhoilsíonn an soláthraí ceann (fág folamh le ríomh uathoibríoch)

settings.llm.reservePct.desc.original: Safety reserve for output tokens (0.10 = 10%, default: {default})
settings.llm.reservePct.desc.translation: Cúltaca sábháilteachta do chomharthaí aschuir (0.10 = 10%, réamhshocrú: {default})

settings.llm.temperature.desc.original: Controls randomness of output (0-1). Lower is more focused, higher is more creative. Current value: {value}
settings.llm.temperature.desc.translation: Rialaíonn sé randamacht an aschuir (0-1). Is dírithe an luach íseal, is cruthaithí an luach ard. Luach reatha: {value}

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.name.translation: Cuir an dáta roimh theideal an nóta

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.original: Automatically add date to the beginning of note filenames
settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.translation: Cuir an dáta go huathoibríoch ag tús ainmneacha na gcomhad nóta

settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.original: Format for date prepended to note titles
settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.translation: Formáid an dáta a chuirtear roimh theidil na nótaí

settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating fast summaries
settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.translation: Treoracha d'iompar na llms agus achoimrí tapa á nginiúint

settings.prompts.userFast.desc.original: Specific instructions for summarizing the transcript quickly and concisely
settings.prompts.userFast.desc.translation: Treoracha sonracha chun an tras-scríbhinn a achoimriú go tapa agus go gonta

settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.original: Please summarize the following YouTube transcript...
settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.translation: Déan achoimre ar an tras-scríbhinn YouTube seo a leanas...

settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating detailed, comprehensive summaries
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.translation: Treoracha d'iompar na llms agus achoimrí mionsonraithe cuimsitheacha á nginiúint

settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.original: Specific instructions for creating detailed and structured notes from the transcript
settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.translation: Treoracha sonracha chun nótaí mionsonraithe struchtúrtha a chruthú ón tras-scríbhinn

settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.original: From the transcript below, create detailed and structured notes...
settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.translation: Ón tras-scríbhinn thíos, cruthaigh nótaí mionsonraithe struchtúrtha...

settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.original: Choose the default summary mode to use when the plugin starts. Fast summary mode skips timestamp links for quicker processing.
settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.translation: Roghnaigh an modh achoimre réamhshocraithe nuair a thosaíonn an breiseán. Fágann an modh tapa naisc stampaí ama ar lár le go mbeidh an próiseáil níos tapa.

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.name.translation: Cuir naisc stampaí ama YouTube leis

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.original: Add links to each numbered section heading that jump to the corresponding timestamp in the YouTube video (note: disabled in fast summary mode)
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.translation: Cuir nasc le gach ceannteideal rannóige uimhrithe a léimeann chuig an stampa ama comhfhreagrach san fhíseán YouTube (nóta: díchumasaithe sa mhodh achoimre tapa)

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.original: When enabled, reduces first pass tokens by 12% to make room for links. Automatically disabled in fast summary mode.
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.translation: Nuair atá sé cumasaithe, laghdaíonn sé comharthaí an chéad phas faoi 12% chun spás a dhéanamh do na naisc. Díchumasaítear go huathoibríoch é sa mhodh achoimre tapa.

settings.advanced.info.original: Advanced settings for debugging and troubleshooting. Enable debug logging to get detailed information appended to each note for technical support.
settings.advanced.info.translation: Socruithe casta le haghaidh dífhabhtaithe agus fabhtcheartaithe. Cumasaigh logáil dhífhabhtaithe chun eolas mionsonraithe a chur le gach nóta le haghaidh tacaíochta teicniúla.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.original: Enable detailed debug logs. When enabled, debug information will be appended to each note as a hidden callout for troubleshooting.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.translation: Cumasaigh logaí mionsonraithe dífhabhtaithe. Nuair atá sé cumasaithe, cuirfear eolas dífhabhtaithe le gach nóta mar bhosca folaithe le haghaidh fabhtcheartaithe.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.original: When enabled, debug information will be collected and added to notes as a hidden callout instead of being logged to the console.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.translation: Nuair atá sé cumasaithe, baileofar eolas dífhabhtaithe agus cuirfear leis na nótaí é mar bhosca folaithe in ionad é a logáil chuig an gconsól.

license.modal.loadError.original: Could not load license file. Please check that a license file exists in your plugin directory.
license.modal.loadError.translation: Níorbh fhéidir comhad an cheadúnais a lódáil. Deimhnigh go bhfuil comhad ceadúnais i gcomhadlann do bhreiseáin.

license.required.message.original: You must accept the plugin license before using this feature.
license.required.message.translation: Caithfidh tú glacadh le ceadúnas an bhreiseáin sula n-úsáideann tú an ghné seo.

license.required.instruction.original: Please go to the plugin settings and accept the license terms to continue.
license.required.instruction.translation: Téigh chuig socruithe an bhreiseáin agus glac le téarmaí an cheadúnais chun leanúint ar aghaidh.

license.required.step2.original: Scroll down to the "Community Plugins" section in the sidebar
license.required.step2.translation: Scrollaigh síos chuig rannóg bhreiseáin an phobail sa bharra taoibh

license.required.step3.original: Find "Tubesage" in the Community Plugins list
license.required.step3.translation: Aimsigh “Tubesage” i liosta bhreiseáin an phobail

license.required.step5.original: Toggle "Accept license & disclaimer" to enable the plugin
license.required.step5.translation: Cas air “Glac leis an gceadúnas & leis an séanadh” chun an breiseán a chumasú

notice.apiKey.missing.original: Youtube transcript plugin: no API key configured for {provider}. Add your API key in the plugin settings.
notice.apiKey.missing.translation: Breiseán tras-scríbhinní Youtube: níl eochair API cumraithe do {provider}. Cuir d'eochair API leis i socruithe an bhreiseáin.

notice.job.interrupted.original: Processing was interrupted; resume it from "Show active jobs"
notice.job.interrupted.translation: Cuireadh isteach ar an bpróiseáil; lean ar aghaidh ó “Taispeáin jabanna gníomhacha”

notice.debugNote.created.original: Error note created with debug information: {file}
notice.debugNote.created.translation: Cruthaíodh nóta earráide le heolas dífhabhtaithe: {file}

notice.debugNote.failed.original: Error: {error} (Also failed to create debug note)
notice.debugNote.failed.translation: Earráid: {error} (níorbh fhéidir an nóta dífhabhtaithe a chruthú ach oiread)

notice.recovery.checkFailed.original: Could not check for interrupted jobs: {error}
notice.recovery.checkFailed.translation: Níorbh fhéidir seiceáil a dhéanamh ar phoist idirbhriste: {error}

notice.transcript.noTimestamps.original: Warning: No timestamps found in transcript. Timestamps are required for proper processing.
notice.transcript.noTimestamps.translation: Rabhadh: níor aimsíodh aon stampa ama sa tras-scríbhinn. Tá stampaí ama riachtanach don phróiseáil.

notice.templater.required.original: Error: Templater plugin is required but not installed or enabled
notice.templater.required.translation: Earráid: tá an breiseán Templater riachtanach ach níl sé suiteáilte ná cumasaithe

notice.note.createFailed.translation: Earráid agus an nóta á chruthú: {error}

notice.templater.missing.original: Youtube transcript plugin requires the Templater plugin. Please install and enable it.
notice.templater.missing.translation: Teastaíonn an breiseán Templater ón mbreiseán tras-scríbhinní Youtube. Suiteáil agus cumasaigh é.

notice.collection.fetchingPlaylistVideos.translation: Físeáin an tseinmliosta á bhfáil (ar lean)...

notice.collection.safetyLimit.original: Reached safety limit of {limit} videos. Processing the first {limit} videos.
notice.collection.safetyLimit.translation: Sroicheadh an teorainn sábháilteachta de {limit} físeán. Próiseálfar an chéad {limit} físeán.

notice.collection.fetchingChannelVideosM.translation: Físeáin an chainéil á bhfáil (ar lean)...

notice.timestamps.adding.translation: Naisc stampa ama á gcur leis le LLM...

notice.timestamps.retrying.translation: Ag triail arís le teorainn comharthaí níos ísle...

notice.timestamps.failed.translation: Níorbh fhéidir naisc stampa ama a chur leis: {error}

notice.timestamps.added.original: Added timestamp links to {count} section headings
notice.timestamps.added.translation: Cuireadh naisc stampa ama le {count} ceannteideal

notice.translate.emptyResponse.original: Failed to translate content (empty response from LLM)
notice.translate.emptyResponse.translation: Níorbh fhéidir an t-ábhar a aistriú (freagra folamh ón LLM)

notice.models.apiKeyMissing.original: {provider} API key is missing. Cannot fetch models.
notice.models.apiKeyMissing.translation: Tá eochair API {provider} ar iarraidh. Ní féidir na múnlaí a fháil.

notice.models.parseFailed.original: Could not parse {provider} models from API response.
notice.models.parseFailed.translation: Níorbh fhéidir múnlaí {provider} a léamh as freagra an API.

notice.timestamps.addedChunked.original: Added {count} timestamp links using chunked processing
notice.timestamps.addedChunked.translation: Cuireadh {count} nasc stampa ama leis trí phróiseáil ina blúirí

notice.extractor.ready.translation: Tá an t-asbhainteoir tras-scríbhinní Youtube réidh

modal.create.titlePlaceholder.original: Leave empty to use YouTube title
modal.create.titlePlaceholder.translation: Fág folamh chun teideal YouTube a úsáid

modal.create.urlInvalid.original: Not a valid YouTube URL. Only video, playlist, and channel urls are supported.
modal.create.urlInvalid.translation: Ní URL bailí YouTube é. Ní thacaítear ach le URLanna físeáin, seinmliosta agus cainéil.

modal.create.title.original: Tubesage: create note from YouTube transcript
modal.create.title.translation: Tubesage: cruthaigh nóta ó thras-scríbhinn YouTube

modal.create.urlPlaylist.original: YouTube channel or playlist URL detected
modal.create.urlPlaylist.translation: Braitheadh URL cainéil nó seinmliosta YouTube

modal.create.videoCountPrompt.original: How many videos would you like to process? Max hard limit is 50.
modal.create.videoCountPrompt.translation: Cé mhéad físeán is mian leat a phróiseáil? Is é 50 an teorainn dhocht.

modal.create.fastModeDesc.original: Enable for shorter, quicker summaries (skips timestamp links)
modal.create.fastModeDesc.translation: Achoimrí níos giorra agus níos tapúla (scipeálann naisc stampa ama)

modal.jobs.loadError.original: Could not read the job list: {error}
modal.jobs.loadError.translation: Níorbh fhéidir liosta na dtascanna a léamh: {error}

modal.jobs.discardHint.original: Discard removes a job from this list; it never deletes notes.
modal.jobs.discardHint.translation: Baineann Cuir i leataobh tasc den liosta seo; ní scriosann sé nótaí riamh.

modal.templatePicker.empty.original: No template files found in "{folder}" folder. Make sure your template folder is correctly configured in Templater settings.
modal.templatePicker.empty.translation: Níor aimsíodh comhaid teimpléid san fhillteán “{folder}”. Deimhnigh go bhfuil fillteán na dteimpléad socraithe i gceart i socruithe Templater.

modal.readme.loadError.original: Could not load readme file. Please check that readme.md exists in your plugin directory.
modal.readme.loadError.translation: Níorbh fhéidir an comhad readme a luchtú. Deimhnigh go bhfuil readme.md i bhfillteán an bhreiseáin.

modal.template.title.original: Example template: copy and place in your templater plugin specified template directory
modal.template.title.translation: Teimpléad samplach: cóipeáil é go fillteán na dteimpléad atá socraithe i Templater

modal.template.explanation.original: This is the example templater plugin template used for YouTube transcript notes. You can customize this template for your own needs.
modal.template.explanation.translation: Seo an teimpléad samplach Templater a úsáidtear le nótaí tras-scríbhinní YouTube. Is féidir leat é a chur in oiriúint duit féin.

modal.template.loadError.original: Could not load template file. Please check that the template exists in your plugin directory or vault templates folder.
modal.template.loadError.translation: Níorbh fhéidir an comhad teimpléid a luchtú. Deimhnigh go bhfuil sé i bhfillteán an bhreiseáin nó i bhfillteán teimpléad na taisce.

notice.collection.start.playlist.translation: Ag tosú ar sheinmliosta YouTube a phróiseáil: {name}

notice.collection.start.channel.translation: Ag tosú ar chainéal YouTube a phróiseáil: {name}

notice.job.saveFailed.original: Could not save the job: {error}. The video may still be processing; check "Show active jobs"
notice.job.saveFailed.translation: Níorbh fhéidir an tasc a shábháil: {error}. D'fhéadfadh an físeán a bheith á phróiseáil fós; féach “Taispeáin jabanna gníomhacha”

notice.job.alreadyRunning.original: This video is already being processed
notice.job.alreadyRunning.translation: Tá an físeán seo á phróiseáil cheana

notice.job.cannotResume.original: This job cannot be resumed as it is; see its status
notice.job.cannotResume.translation: Ní féidir an tasc seo a atosú mar atá; féach a stádas

notice.job.cannotFinish.original: This job cannot be finished as it is; see its status
notice.job.cannotFinish.translation: Ní féidir an tasc seo a chríochnú mar atá; féach a stádas

modal.template.var.title.desc.original: - The title of the Youtube video

modal.template.var.videoUrl.desc.original: - The URL of the Youtube video

modal.template.var.transcript.desc.translation: - An tras-scríbhinn iomlán le stampaí ama

modal.template.var.summary.desc.original: - The LLM-generated summary of the video
modal.template.var.summary.desc.translation: - Achoimre an fhíseáin a ghin an LLM

modal.template.var.llmProvider.desc.original: - The LLM provider used (e.g., openai, anthropic)
modal.template.var.llmProvider.desc.translation: - An soláthraí LLM a úsáideadh (m.sh. openai, anthropic)

modal.template.var.llmModel.desc.original: - The specific model used (e.g., gpt-4, claude-3-opus)
modal.template.var.llmModel.desc.translation: - An tsainmhúnla a úsáideadh (m.sh. gpt-4, claude-3-opus)

modal.template.var.llmTags.desc.original: - Tags generated from the LLM provider and model
modal.template.var.llmTags.desc.translation: - Clibeanna a ghintear ón soláthraí agus ón múnla LLM

notice.models.providerSet.original: Provider set to {provider}. Output budget: {tokens} tokens (max output minus reserve).
notice.models.providerSet.translation: Socraíodh an soláthraí go {provider}. Buiséad aschuir: {tokens} comhartha (uaschur lúide an cúlchiste).

notice.models.modelChanged.original: Model changed to {model}. Output budget: {tokens} tokens (max output minus reserve).
notice.models.modelChanged.translation: Athraíodh an tsamhail go {model}. Buiséad aschuir: {tokens} comhartha (uaschur lúide an cúlchiste).

notice.models.refreshFailed.original: Could not refresh {provider} models. Using existing list.
notice.models.refreshFailed.translation: Níorbh fhéidir samhlacha {provider} a athnuachan. Úsáidfear an liosta atá ann.

notice.collection.noVideos.playlist.original: No videos found in this playlist
notice.collection.noVideos.playlist.translation: Níor aimsíodh aon fhíseán sa seinmliosta seo

notice.collection.noVideos.channel.original: No videos found in this channel
notice.collection.noVideos.channel.translation: Níor aimsíodh aon fhíseán ar an gcainéal seo

notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.one.original: {provider} model list refreshed. Token limits auto-populated for {count} model.
notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.one.translation: Athnuadhadh liosta samhlacha {provider}. Líonadh teorainneacha comharthaí go huathoibríoch do {count} shamhail.

notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.two.translation: Athnuadhadh liosta samhlacha {provider}. Líonadh teorainneacha comharthaí go huathoibríoch do {count} shamhail.

notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.few.translation: Athnuadhadh liosta samhlacha {provider}. Líonadh teorainneacha comharthaí go huathoibríoch do {count} shamhla.

notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.many.translation: Athnuadhadh liosta samhlacha {provider}. Líonadh teorainneacha comharthaí go huathoibríoch do {count} samhla.

notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.other.original: {provider} model list refreshed. Token limits auto-populated for {count} models.
notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.other.translation: Athnuadhadh liosta samhlacha {provider}. Líonadh teorainneacha comharthaí go huathoibríoch do {count} samhail.

modal.jobs.closed.noNote.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; no note was created
modal.jobs.closed.noNote.translation: Cuireadh isteach air nuair a dúnadh Obsidian; níor cruthaíodh aon nóta

modal.jobs.closed.mayExist.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; a note may exist at {path}
modal.jobs.closed.mayExist.translation: Cuireadh isteach air nuair a dúnadh Obsidian; seans go bhfuil nóta ag {path}

modal.jobs.closed.withoutTimestamps.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; the note was created without timestamps
modal.jobs.closed.withoutTimestamps.translation: Cuireadh isteach air nuair a dúnadh Obsidian; cruthaíodh an nóta gan stampaí ama

modal.jobs.closed.withoutTranslation.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; the note was created without translation
modal.jobs.closed.withoutTranslation.translation: Cuireadh isteach air nuair a dúnadh Obsidian; cruthaíodh an nóta gan aistriúchán

modal.jobs.reason.paidStageInFlight.original: Interrupted during {stage}; the previous request may already have been billed
modal.jobs.reason.paidStageInFlight.translation: Cuireadh isteach air le linn {stage}; seans gur billeadh an t-iarratas roimhe seo cheana

modal.jobs.reason.unknownBilling.original: Interrupted during {stage}; billing for the previous request is unknown
modal.jobs.reason.unknownBilling.translation: Cuireadh isteach air le linn {stage}; ní fios ar billeadh an t-iarratas roimhe seo

modal.jobs.reason.noteCollision.original: A note already exists at the target path — rename or remove it, then resume from Show active jobs
modal.jobs.reason.noteCollision.translation: Tá nóta ann cheana ag an gconair sprice — athainmnigh nó bain é, ansin lean ar aghaidh ó “Taispeáin jabanna gníomhacha”

modal.jobs.reason.claimUnresolved.original: Could not confirm whether the note at the target path belongs to this job
modal.jobs.reason.claimUnresolved.translation: Níorbh fhéidir a dhearbhú an leis an jab seo an nóta atá ag an gconair sprice

modal.jobs.reason.noteMissing.original: The note for this job was moved or deleted
modal.jobs.reason.noteMissing.translation: Bogadh nó scriosadh nóta an jab seo

modal.jobs.reason.noteChanged.original: The note was edited during processing; timestamps were skipped
modal.jobs.reason.noteChanged.translation: Cuireadh an nóta in eagar le linn na próiseála; fágadh na stampaí ama ar lár

modal.jobs.reason.templaterUnavailable.original: Templater is not available; enable it, then resume
modal.jobs.reason.templaterUnavailable.translation: Níl Templater ar fáil; cumasaigh é, ansin lean ar aghaidh

modal.jobs.reason.paidRefetch.original: Resuming re-fetches the transcript through a paid service
modal.jobs.reason.paidRefetch.translation: Má leantar ar aghaidh, gheofar an tras-scríbhinn arís trí sheirbhís íoctha

modal.jobs.reason.pathDrift.original: The note path could not be computed consistently (check folder and date settings), then resume
modal.jobs.reason.pathDrift.translation: Níorbh fhéidir conair an nóta a ríomh go comhsheasmhach (seiceáil socruithe an fhillteáin agus an dáta), ansin lean ar aghaidh

notice.note.done.created.translation: Cruthaíodh nóta na tras-scríbhinne go rathúil

notice.note.done.timestampsEdited.original: Note created, but timestamps were skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.timestampsEdited.translation: Cruthaíodh an nóta, ach fágadh na stampaí ama ar lár toisc gur cuireadh an nóta in eagar

notice.note.done.translationEdited.original: Note created, but the translation was skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.translationEdited.translation: Cruthaíodh an nóta, ach fágadh an t-aistriúchán ar lár toisc gur cuireadh an nóta in eagar

notice.note.done.bothEdited.original: Note created, but timestamps and the translation were skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.bothEdited.translation: Cruthaíodh an nóta, ach fágadh na stampaí ama agus an t-aistriúchán ar lár toisc gur cuireadh an nóta in eagar

notice.note.done.withoutBoth.original: Note created without timestamps or translation
notice.note.done.withoutBoth.translation: Cruthaíodh an nóta gan stampaí ama agus gan aistriúchán

notice.coldStart.single.noNote.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: no note was created
notice.coldStart.single.noNote.translation: TubeSage: cuireadh isteach ar 1 jab nóta nuair a dúnadh Obsidian — {title}: níor cruthaíodh aon nóta

notice.coldStart.single.mayExist.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: a note may exist at {path}
notice.coldStart.single.mayExist.translation: TubeSage: cuireadh isteach ar 1 jab nóta nuair a dúnadh Obsidian — {title}: seans go bhfuil nóta ag {path}

notice.coldStart.single.withoutTimestamp.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: note was created without timestamps
notice.coldStart.single.withoutTimestamp.translation: TubeSage: cuireadh isteach ar 1 jab nóta nuair a dúnadh Obsidian — {title}: cruthaíodh an nóta gan stampaí ama

notice.coldStart.single.withoutTranslati.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: note was created without translation
notice.coldStart.single.withoutTranslati.translation: TubeSage: cuireadh isteach ar 1 jab nóta nuair a dúnadh Obsidian — {title}: cruthaíodh an nóta gan aistriúchán

notice.coldStart.several.original: TubeSage: {count} note jobs were interrupted when Obsidian closed; the most recent are listed under Show active jobs
notice.coldStart.several.translation: TubeSage: cuireadh isteach ar {count} jab nóta nuair a dúnadh Obsidian; tá na cinn is déanaí liostaithe faoi “Taispeáin jabanna gníomhacha”

notice.recovery.single.translation: TubeSage: tá aird de dhíth ar 1 jab a cuireadh isteach air

notice.recovery.several.translation: TubeSage: tá aird de dhíth ar {count} jab a cuireadh isteach orthu

common.validation.required.translation: Líon isteach an réimse {field}, le do thoil

common.transcript.unavailable.original: No transcript is available for this video
common.transcript.unavailable.translation: Níl tras-scríbhinn ar fáil don fhíseán seo
